yt_description:
Prepare for chaos! 🌪️ We're diving into the legendarily terrible Bogo Sort, also known as permutation sort or shotgun sort. Watch as we (try to) sort a list using pure luck and random shuffling. Will it be faster than a snail? Will it break the internet? Probably not, but it's hilarious! 🤪

Join us for this mind-bending (and rage-inducing) look at one of computer science's most absurd concepts. Perfect for anyone who loves coding, hates efficiency, or just wants a good laugh at the expense of algorithms.
